description: This PHP class 'LocalizationService' provides comprehensive functionalities for managing localization within a Human Resource Management system, including handling translation strings, validating XLIFF files, exporting language packages, and managing language-specific data.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: A service class that manages localization operations such as translation management, file validation, export/import of language data, and error handling within the system.

methods.name: getLocalizationDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization and retrieval of the Localization Data Access Object.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the service container.

methods.name: getLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Returns an array of supported localization date formats with sample formatted dates.

methods.name: getSupportedDateFormats
methods.description: Provides a list of all supported date format strings and their labels.

methods.name: getCurrentDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the current default date format based on system configuration.

methods.name: getSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves an array of enabled and recently added languages for localization.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Searches for languages based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesArray
methods.description: Normalizes and returns language data as an array.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves or updates translated strings in the database for a specified language from provided data rows.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStringsFromRows
methods.description: Saves import error strings associated with a language and employee number.

methods.name: createTranslatedItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates I18NTranslation objects from data rows for saving translations.

methods.name: createImportErrorItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates I18NImportError objects from data rows indicating errors during import.

methods.name: generateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for language strings based on language and string IDs.

methods.name: exportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Exports language translations into an XLIFF XML string.

methods.name: getXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Creates an XML DOM document representing translations suitable for XLIFF export.

methods.name: getTargetLanguageFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the target language code from an XLIFF DOM document.

methods.name: validateTargetString
methods.description: Validates a translation string against source string placeholders and syntax.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NError object based on its name.

methods.name: processXliffFile
methods.description: Processes an uploaded XLIFF file, validating structure and content, returning processed language strings.

methods.name: validateXliffFile
methods.description: Validates an XLIFF file for correct schema, version, target language, and overall XML validity.

methods.name: validateLangStrings
methods.description: Validates language strings in an XLIFF content, checking for correctness and returning valid/invalid results.

methods.name: languageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if there are import errors associated with a language and employee number.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Clears import error records for specified language strings.
